prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported whiplash. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1480; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the scene, I observed two vehicles stopped in the right and center lanes of the eastbound access road in Sugar Land, Texas, with minor damage to the right rear quarter panel of Vehicle 1 and the left front fender of Vehicle 2. Driver 1 stated that they were changing lanes to the left when Vehicle 2 moved into their lane from the rear and made contact along the side of Vehicle 1. Driver 2 stated that they did not see Vehicle 1 signal or check its mirrors before the lane change. Both vehicles were operable and were driven from the lanes of travel after photographs were taken. Driver 1 reported neck and upper back pain consistent with whiplash and declined transport by EMS at the scene. A passenger in Vehicle 1 reported no injuries. Weather was clear and the road surface was dry. Both drivers exchanged insurance information. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review.
